text_block_list.name: Local Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's amazing, Furioso-chan!
You'd never guess you're a beginner with skills like that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Yes.
Little by little, I'm starting to get the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Local Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
! Ahh, sorry to keep you under the blazing sun!
Let's take a break soon—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No, I'm just getting an adrenaline rush from the excitement.
There's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's move on to the next hole!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A meet-and-greet with the members of our fan club.
Let's enjoy it to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...gh...
Once we get back, we really should get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the outdoor mixer under the sun, I ended up coming down with a dreadful headache...
